full_prompt_en: A square, luminous figurative painting shows a young woman in a white dress seated beside an open, flower-filled window. The left half is bright with a small balcony and crowded pots of foliage and blossoms; beyond the dark vertical railings, pale buildings and soft color blur into daylight. A low ledge beneath the window holds a narrow bottle and a clear glass vessel, whose small glints contrast with the dense dark interior. The woman occupies the right center, her head bowed as she looks toward her folded hands. Brown hair is gathered loosely at the back, with warm strands catching the window light. Her dress has short ruffled sleeves, a light fitted bodice, and a full skirt covered in loose cream and gray-blue strokes. One leg extends diagonally toward the lower left, with a dark sandal touching the warm reddish floor. The other foot remains closer to the pooled skirt. At the right edge, deep shadow and a large potted plant enclose her figure, making the window's brightness more pronounced. Small floral colors, including lavender and soft pink, punctuate the otherwise green and ivory background. Visible brushmarks vary from soft blended skin tones to quick broken white highlights on fabric and rough, leafy dabs outside. The floor shows broad reddish-brown strokes and irregular patches of reflected light, grounding the seated pose. Sunlight enters from the upper left through the opening, lighting the shoulder, dress, and foreground tiles while leaving the far wall and foliage in cool shade. The overall composition places a quiet, downward-looking figure between abundant sunlit growth and a dark interior, with sparkling paint and warm-cool contrast carrying the intimate mood.
full_prompt_zh: 这幅方形、明亮的人物绘画描绘一位穿白裙的年轻女子坐在满是花草的敞开窗边。左半边的小阳台上花盆、枝叶和花朵拥挤，光线明亮；深色竖向栏杆之外，浅色建筑和柔和色彩融入日光。窗下低矮台面放着一只细瓶和一只透明玻璃器皿，微小亮点与浓暗的室内形成对比。女子位于中间偏右处，低头看着交叠的双手。棕发松松地收在脑后，暖色发丝接住窗光。裙子有短荷叶袖、浅色合身上身和由松散奶油色、灰蓝色笔触覆盖的宽大裙摆。一条腿斜伸向左下方，深色凉鞋落在暖红色地板上；另一只脚靠近堆叠的裙摆。右侧边缘，深影和一盆大型植物围住她，使窗边亮度更突出。薰衣草紫与浅粉等细小花色点缀以绿色和象牙白为主的背景。可见笔触从柔和融合的肤色、衣料上快速断续的白色高光，变化到窗外粗略的叶片点笔。地板用宽阔红褐笔触和不规则反光色块表现，稳住坐姿。阳光从左上方经窗洞进入，照亮肩膀、裙子和前景地砖，远墙与枝叶则留在冷色阴影中。整体构图把低头静坐的人物置于丰盛受光的植物与幽暗室内之间，以闪亮笔触和冷暖对比承载亲密气氛。
style_prompt_en: The image has a luminous, painterly surface built from loose strokes, soft blending, and broken highlights. Ivory and warm cream forms emerge from deep olive and brown shadow, while cool blue-gray notes temper the sunlight and small floral colors provide scattered accents. Edges are sharpest at the main light-dark boundaries and melt into clustered, leaf-like marks in the surrounding areas. Illumination enters strongly from one side, creating bright patches on upper planes and warm reflected touches below, with the opposite side held in deep but colorful shade. Textured dabs and broad sweeping marks coexist, giving nearby surfaces weight without smoothing away the brushwork. The overall composition feels intimate and sun-washed, with a bright open area balanced against a sheltered dark mass.
style_prompt_zh: 图像具有由松散笔触、柔和融合与断续高光构成的明亮绘画表面。象牙白与暖奶油色形体从深橄榄和褐色阴影中显现，冷灰蓝色压住日光的热度，细小花色成为散落点缀。主要明暗交界处边缘最清楚，周围区域则融化为成簇、近似叶片的笔触。光从一侧强烈进入，在上表面形成亮斑，在下方留下暖色反射，对侧则保留深而有色的阴影。带纹理的点笔与宽扫笔触共存，使近处表面有重量，同时不抹平笔迹。整体构图亲密而沐浴日光，以明亮开口平衡受遮蔽的深色体块。
theme_en: A young woman in a white dress sitting beside a flower-filled window
theme_zh: 年轻女子穿白裙坐在花草环绕的窗边
name: Vicente Romero Redondo
